config.note: The current price, as against the monthly benchmarks in wb-commodities. Crude and Henry Hub gas are daily from 1986, 1987 and 1997; the two pump prices are weekly from 1990 and 1994. Full dates are kept, so these are the actual quotes rather than a month-end snapshot — resample with frequency='annual_mean' before mixing them with monthly or annual data. Nominal USD, not seasonally adjusted, and the pump prices include federal and state taxes while the crude and gas quotes do not.
